profile.constituencyprofile_Text:
The Gannavaram Assembly Constituency Vision Action Plan 2024-29 has been meticulously designed to leverage the constituency's agricultural strength, dynamic industrial base, thriving construction sector, and robust service sector. This strategic blueprint aligns with Andhra Pradesh’s ambitious Swarna Andhra @ 2047 vision, which resonates with the national agenda of Viksit Bharat@2047.

Gannavaram Constituency consists of four mandals: Gannavaram, Bapulapadu, Unguturu and Part of Vijayawada Rural of NTR District. These are located in the Krishna and NTR Districts of Andhra Pradesh, with Gannavaram serving as the headquarters.

The Gannavaram Constituency formed in the year 1955 with delimitation orders 1955. Sri Puchalapalli Sundarayya was the first member of the legislative assembly for the gannavaram constituency. The name Gannavaram is based on the traditional Sanskrit words “Ganna” meaning Sugarcane and “Varam” meaning blessing. Historically Gannavaram used to be a primarily Sugarcane-producing establishment. Hence named Gannavaram “Blessed with Sugarcane”.

Gannavaram stands out for its significant contributions to agriculture and Industrial Sector. Its strategic location, with excellent highway connectivity to major urban centers like Vijayawada, Eluru, Nuzvidu and Gudivada, enhances its potential for trade and industrial development. Additionally, Constituency have international airport to become a regional logistics gateway, these unique advantages position the constituency to achieve an ambitious annual growth target of 15% across all key sectors.
profile.geography: The Gannavaram constituency spans 670.393 sq. km. It has black cotton and red soils, supporting extensive paddy cultivation. Major water resources are Budameru and Eluru Canal Systems.
profile.populationDesc:
Population (2011 Census): 2,26,272 people, with 1,12,238 males and 1,14,034 females. The sex ratio stands at 980 females per 1,000 males.

Households: There are 63284 households.
profile.administrationDesc: Gannavaram Constituency is one of the seven assembly constituencies in Krishna District. It has Gannavaram, Bapulapadu, Unguturu and Part of Vijayawada Rural
profile.educationHealthcareDesc: Gannavaram has a comprehensive educational landscape with 143 primary schools, 19 upper primary schools, 29 high schools, and various higher education institutions, including engineering, medical, and veterinary colleges. The area also has residential schools and welfare hostels. Healthcare infrastructure includes 1 CHC, 8 PHCs, 86 sub-centers, and emergency services like 104 and 108 ambulance services, ensuring accessible medical care.

economy_text.economy_Text:
Gannavaram's Economy at a Glance 

Gannavaram's economy is poised for transformative growth, targeting a ₹3.83 lakh crore Gross Constituency Domestic Product (GCDP) by 2047–48, with an ambitious annual growth rate of 12–15%. The constituency is currently diversified across services, agriculture, and industry, with a clear focus on inclusive development, infrastructure modernization, and sectoral integration. At present, the services sector is the largest contributor, accounting for 65.82% of the Gross Value Added (GVA), followed by agriculture and allied activities at 19.46%, and industry at 14.72%. Gannavaram benefits from strategic advantages like an international airport, road connectivity (NH-16), and emerging industrial and logistics ecosystems.


Growth Drivers: Airport-linked logistics & aviation services, Digital & IT-enabled services (ITES), MSME & startup ecosystem development, livestock development

Major Clusters: Mini Food Processing Parks, Digital & IT Hub, Tourism & Hospitality
economy_text.gcdP_Growth_Text: Gannavaram is witnessing steady economic momentum with a targeted 12 - 15% annual GCDP growth rate across key sectors like Trade, Tourism, and Logistics. This growth trajectory aligns with the long-term vision of making the constituency a vibrant economic hub by 2047.
